summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing TSX approval for renewal of its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) for preferred shares. The bid allows repurchase of up to 10% of the public float of each of 19 series of Class A Preference Shares over the period August 24, 2026 to August 23, 2027. Purchases will be made on the open market at prevailing market prices, subject to daily volume limits. This is a routine issuer repurchase program, not a tender offer, with no premium, board recommendation, or advisors. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and potential support for preferred share prices.
